title: Mbongo Tjobi (Afrik)
author: Amina Savoura (Afrik.com)
desc: Machoiron (or catfish, carp, eel) steaks in a paste of crushed onions, garlic, tomato and djansan with mbongo spices, oil poured on top and cooked about 30 minutes on low heat.
longDesc: The Afrik printing describes a plat traditionnel particularly popular among the Bassa people of the Littoral province. Onions, garlic, tomato and djansan are crushed. The fish is washed, gutted, cut into steaks and salted, put in a terrine with the crushed mix, the mbongo spices and a little water, and mixed; it is then moved to a pot, oil poured on top, covered and cooked on low heat about 30 minutes. The only sauce cue is to check its smoothness (onctuosité), thinning with a little water if too thick. Served very hot.
ingredients: 2 kg machoiron (or silure/catfish, carp or eel)
Salt and stock cubes — quantities not printed
steps: Crush the onions, garlic, tomato and djansan.
Wash, gut and cut the fish into steaks. Salt them.
Put the fish in a terrine with the crushed mix, the mbongo spices and a little water. Taste for seasoning and mix.
Move everything to a pot, pour the oil on top, cover and cook on low heat about 30 minutes.
Check the sauce’s smoothness; thin with a little water if it is too thick. Serve very hot.
chefTips: The only printed cue is the sauce’s smoothness (‘onctuosité’).
Thin with a little water if the sauce is too thick.
The page does not give a doneness cue for the fish beyond the 30 minutes.
commonMistakes: Letting the pot dry out — the page cooks it covered on low heat.
Using too little salt on the fish steaks before the mix goes on.
Forgetting to thin an over-thick sauce.
healthBenefits: Fish is the main protein; the sauce is built on vegetables and spices.
culturalNote: The page says the dish is particularly popular among the Bassa people of the Littoral province. The page byline is Amina Savoura and the credit is ‘Afrik’.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Mbongo tjobi ou mbongo tchobi’ (page also uses ‘Ongo Tjobi’). Byline as printed: ‘Amina Savoura’; credit ‘Afrik’. ‘Publié le 7 novembre 2017 à 21h09’. Yield not printed (servings 8 is a placeholder for the app). TWO-PASS; the second pass adds the ‘goûter l’assaisonnement’ step.

Printed as is: ‘ne marmite’ (typo for ‘une marmite’). ABSENT: amounts of salt and cubes; prep time (20 here is a placeholder); how the mbongo spices are prepared (burning of the bark is not described).
